newsitem.title: USA: Burlington sees H1 97 hurt, hopeful for H2.
newsitem.headline: Burlington sees H1 97 hurt, hopeful for H2.

text.p: Burlington Industries Inc on Thursday reiterated that the fiscal 1997 first half would be hurt by reductions in denim inventories, after reporting lower fourth quarter earnings.
The company said it is hopeful about the 1997 last half.

"As we noted in September, our results will be negatively affected in the first half of 1997 as inventory accumulations in denim are reduced, but we remain optimistic about our prospects for the last half of the year," the company stated.
Today the company said fourth quarter earnings were $0.19 per share, down from $0.21 a year ago. Fiscal 1996 results were $0.65 after charges, compared to $1.05 in 1995.
